name: Bot Handy
def: Concept home robot from Samsung, a wheeled column with one arm meant to load dishwashers, set tables and pour drinks.
facts: Shown at CES in January 2021 alongside Bot Care
Uses a camera and AI to recognise objects and judge how hard to grip them

refs.label: Samsung's latest home robots can do chores and nag you to stop working, Engadget
Samsung's Bot Handy can put away dishes, set a table, and pour drinks for you, TechSpot
